sections.body: PLAGIARISM is presenting someone else's words or ideas as your own. In school and work it's taken seriously: failing an assignment, losing a job, or worse.
Changing a few words (patchwriting) is still plagiarism if the ideas and structure are someone else's and you don't credit them.
Avoid it by: putting exact words in quotation marks with a citation; paraphrasing in your own words AND citing the source; keeping a list of sources while you research.
A citation tells readers where an idea came from (author, title, date, publisher or URL) so they can check it. Common styles are APA, MLA and Chicago.
Using AI: if you use an AI tool to help, follow your school's rules and say how you used it. AI can also invent fake sources, so always check that a source really exists.
Common knowledge (e.g. 'Paris is the capital of France') usually doesn't need a citation. Statistics and specific claims do.

quiz.q: You rewrite a paragraph from a website, changing some words, but keep the ideas and don't cite it. Is this plagiarism?
options: Yes: the ideas still need credit
Only if you copied every word
hints: Plagiarism covers ideas, not just exact words.
If you redraw someone's painting in different colours and sign it as yours, is it your original work?
quiz.explain: Yes. Paraphrasing without credit is still plagiarism, because the ideas belong to someone else.

options: 'There are seven days in a week.'
hints: Which is a specific claim someone had to measure?
'Paris is in France' is common knowledge. 'Paris had 2.1 million residents in 2023' needs a source.
quiz.explain: A specific statistic needs a citation so readers can check where it came from.

quiz.q: An AI tool gives you a source for your essay. What should you do?
options: Check that the source exists and says what's claimed
Cite the AI as the original author
hints: Can AI tools make mistakes about sources?
The lesson warned about one specific problem.
If a friend told you a book quote, you'd check the book before quoting it in an essay. Same here.
quiz.explain: AI can invent sources. Always check that a source is real and actually says what's claimed.
